reason: Conjunctival infection defines ocular and infectious_immune involvement. This localized gonococcal subtype does not require renal involvement.
Inherited glomerular disease defines renal involvement. Secondary hypertension is separately diagnosed; the evidence does not establish nail or skeletal disease.
Optic atrophy and the mitochondrial metabolic disorder support both primary axes. Common neurologic damage is not established across this variable umbrella.
Inflammation of the iris and ciliary body defines ocular disease; the usual immune-mediated mechanism supports infectious_immune. No additional organ qualifies.
Defining dental abnormalities support gastrointestinal. Glaucoma, hypotrichosis and digital anomalies are variable, without evidence establishing common involvement or required diagnostic criteria.
Rhabdomyosarcoma supports musculoskeletal origin. Parameningeal location alone establishes neither nervous-system origin nor common direct invasion of another axis.
Peroxisomal metabolic disease with common neurologic dysfunction supports the label. Hepatic and ocular damage are not established as common across the PEX16 spectrum.
Infection defines this umbrella. Urinary and CNS disease depend on viral species and host context; neither is established in at least 30% across the group.
The post-infectious syndrome supports infectious_immune. Persistent pain, fatigue and cognitive symptoms do not establish qualifying direct damage to additional organs.
Reduced hemoglobin defines a haematologic disorder. Prematurity-related anemia does not itself establish infection, immune disease or direct damage to another organ.
